svg.title: Flow diagram. The agent, zn-gate and the tools or MCP servers run on your machine, and tool calls and prompts go through zn-gate. Tool output comes back redacted. Nothing leaves the machine by default. Only with ZN_CLOUD=1 and ZN_API_KEY set, prompts with detected secrets removed go to api.usezn.com, the Galvanize 2 classifier.
